quotes.author: Pamela Thames-Murphy
quotes.text: FUN!FUN!FUN! Janella picked us up from our hotel and provided an upbeat ride to the experience. The safety video provided in the car was easy to follow and was repeated throughout the activity which made me feel confident about what was about to happen. ALLLLLLL the staff were kind, courteous, and eager to assist. If you are looking for a super fun, once in a lifetime experience - this is it!!! IT WAS AWESOME!

quotes.author: Brizette Garcia
quotes.text: I went for my bday and it was the best experience ever. They pick you up at your hotel and the driver is a comedian. Gun safety is number one so don’t play around. I did the helicopter tour and I wish I would have paid for more ammo it’s a once in a lifetime experience and it’s so fast . They walk you through the whole process and you feel like you’re in a movie .

quotes.author: Gene Curry
quotes.text: You know you want to do this, and these guys do everything to make it a memorable experience. This was a birthday present for my son’s 30th birthday, and from the initial contact to the actual experience everyone involved was professional, supportive, and enthusiastic. Thanks for making it a great experience.

quotes.author: Natalia Montalvo
quotes.text: First time I’ve ever shot a gun AND ridden in a helicopter, and I couldn’t have done it at a better place! The entire crew was so kind and so helpful, you can tell they genuinely enjoy what they do. 11/10 would recommend, and will definitely be returning next time I’m in Vegas.
